title: Identification of ligand binding sites in intrinsically disordered proteins with a differential binding score.
one_liner_zh: 该文研究无序蛋白配体结合位点预测，虽涉及蛋白-配体互作与对接方法，但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白质-DNA，且无TF-DNA体系，仅方法可部分借鉴。
abstract: Screening ligands directly binding to an ensemble of intrinsically disordered proteins (IDP) to discover potential hits or leads for new drugs is an emerging but challenging area as IDPs lack well-defined and ordered 3D-protein structures. To explore a new IDP-based rational drug discovery strategy, a differential binding score (DIBS) is defined. The basis of DIBS is to quantitatively determine the binding preference of a ligand to an ensemble of conformations specified by IDP versus such preferences to an ensemble of random coil conformations of the same protein. Ensemble docking procedures performed on repeated sampling of conformations, and the results tested for statistical significance determine the preferential ligand binding sites of the IDP. The results of this approach closely reproduce the experimental data from recent literature on the binding of the ligand epigallocatechin gallate (EGCG) to the intrinsically disordered N-terminal domain of the tumor suppressor p53. Combining established approaches in developing a new method to screen ligands against IDPs could be valuable as a screening tool for IDP-based drug discovery.
abstract_zh: 筛选直接结合于 intrinsically disordered proteins (IDP) 集合的配体，以发现新药的潜在候选物或先导化合物，是一个新兴但具有挑战性的领域，因为 IDP 缺乏明确且有序的三维蛋白质结构。为探索一种基于 IDP 的合理药物发现新策略，定义了一个差异结合评分 (DIBS)。DIBS 的基础是定量确定配体对由 IDP 指定的构象集合的结合偏好，相对于该配体对同一蛋白质随机卷曲构象集合的偏好。对重复构象采样进行的集合对接程序，以及测试统计显著性的结果，确定了 IDP 的优先配体结合位点。该方法的结果紧密重现了近期文献中关于配体表没食子儿茶素没食子酸酯 (EGCG) 与肿瘤抑制因子 p53 的 intrinsically disordered N-terminal domain 结合的实验数据。结合既有方法开发一种筛选针对 IDP 的配体的新方法，可能作为基于 IDP 的药物发现的筛选工具具有价值。
